title: Mr. Driller/Versions
text:
Sony PlayStation
thumb|right
Originally released in North America on May 9, 2000 and in Japan on June 29 of the same year.

Sega Dreamcast
thumb|right
Originally released in North America on June 25, 2000 and in Japan on June 29 of the same year

Game Boy Color
thumb|right
Originally released in Japan on June 29, 2000, and in North America on August 2 of the same year; due to the smaller size of the GBC's screen, the playfield is reduced in size, so it is now only seven blocks wide and nine blocks high. Certain versions released on this platform display the depth in feet, where every block is 5 ft high rather than 1 m high - and it also features a survival mode (where the objective is to drill as deep as possible). 

WonderSwan Color
thumb|right
Released exclusively in Japan on April 15, 2001; this is the only version that was not released overseas.

Mobile Phone
thumb|right
Released on September 20, 2004; an iPhone version was also released on August 28, 2009, but it is currently not depicted here.
